Product leadership & project details.

The vision, operating environment and delivery evidence behind Clarity Dental.

AM

Andrews Mensah

AI Product Director · Product Owner

Andrews defined the product vision, treatment and financing journeys, CRM requirements, architectural direction and delivery priorities. He directed the design, implementation, testing and refinement of the platform.

Product strategyArchitecture directionDelivery leadership

Design & interaction

The visual workspace uses an embedded GrapesJS editor. You can select layers, revise styles, preview responsive layouts and export editable project data. The working application runs separately from canvas edits.

Open design studio

Operating environment

Workspace runtimeInteractive browser studio
Evaluation recordsGenerated project fixtures
FinancingLocal sandbox; simulated funds
External adaptersPartner configuration required

The cost model is trained and evaluated on generated records. Its evaluation results describe that dataset. Aspen Dental, Synchrony and Zest AI inform the integration design; vendor relationships and live clinical/lender connections are established separately.

Browser records stay on this device; role perspectives support walkthroughs rather than real identity verification.
